item.title: Tecnologo: PRJ-2050 TheSPIS- Theaters, Sanctuaries, Performance: Interaction and Sustainability (Horizon MSCADN) (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-20 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ARCH-01 Archeologia

A selection procedure based on qualifications and examinations is hereby launched at the University of Palermo to fill 1 post of Technologist on a part-time (25 hours per week) and fixed-term (36 months, or in any case until the project end date of 31 October 2029) basis, salary grade EP1, to be assigned to the Department of Cultures and Societies.
